summary: A Depth subscription takes Groww's price and book subjects and joins them: a book before any price (a padded empty level is no level), the price merged in, a new book, then an empty book that clears both sides; the unsubscribe releases both subjects.

notes: The fake socket does not echo the nats subprotocol, so each connect is two connections: the first asks for it and is dropped by the feed, the second goes without it (GrowwFeed::on_connect_failed, web nats_websocket.py subprotocol fallback). Connection 2 is the session.

The socket token comes from the fake broker API (env.serve_json in tests/it/feed_corpus/groww.rs, GrowwBroker::with_feed_endpoints). INFO carries no nonce, so CONNECT is the jwt-only form; the signed form is pinned by tests/it/broker_groww_feed.rs, which checks the nonce signature.

deviations.reason: After a book with no level on either side the web sends no best bid or ask; the desktop's snapshot keeps the previous book's (feed/bridge/snapshot.rs: extras overlay, a None never clears one), so the cleared frame shows the last best bid and ask. Needs a shared change asked of the lead: a book that empties a side clears its best price and quantity.
